items.title: Welsh firms ‘Password1’ and ‘Test 2’ fails led to hackers stealing children’s data
items.summary: Alex Hickey reports: Two Welsh organisations have been censured by the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) after a ransomware attack led to the theft of personal data belonging to 3,300 individuals, the vast majority of whom were children. items.title: U.S. bans DeepSeek from government agency systems amid AI rift with China
items.summary: Jenny Lee reports: The Trump administration banned Chinese AI startup DeepSeek from civilian U.S. government agencies, citing security concerns.
